evidence: Add Transaction form's Description and Amount inputs are HTML5 required fields; submitting empty shows native validation message "Please fill out this field." and blocks submission (dialog remains open, no new row added).

issue: Missing category is not blocked or identified
actual: Submitted the Add Transaction form with Description and Amount filled but Category left as "Select category" (unselected). The transaction was created successfully with a blank category (table row shows empty Category cell) instead of being rejected with a validation message.

evidence: Created an Income transaction with type=Income, date=2026-08-25, description='QA Test Income Transaction', amount=555.55, category=Sales Revenue, reference='QA-REF-001', notes='QA automated test notes', tax-related=true. Transaction saved successfully and appeared in the table with all supplied values.
New transaction tx-1787695833799 row displays: 'Aug 25, 2026 QA Test Income Transaction Sales Revenue QA-REF-001 +$555.55 ✓' matching all values supplied on creation.

After adding a current-month (Aug 25 2026) income transaction of $555.55, Dashboard Monthly Income updated from $0 to $556, Net Profit/Loss updated from $0 to $556, and Recent Transactions list immediately showed the new transaction at top - all without page reload.
Sales Revenue category count/total updated from 3 transactions/$36,750 to 4 transactions/$37,305.55 immediately after creating a new $555.55 Sales Revenue transaction.

Switching transaction Type from Expense to Income in the Add Transaction form changed the Category dropdown options from expense categories (Office Supplies, Rent, Utilities...) to income categories (Sales Revenue, Consulting, Interest Income, Other Income). Selected 'Sales Revenue' while type=Income and it was retained/saved correctly with the transaction.

Created category 'QA Test Category' (Expense, blue), edited it to 'QA Test Category Updated' with rose color (confirmed via swatch background-color change), then deleted it successfully; it was removed from the Expense Categories list.

issue: Deleting an in-use category is not blocked and does not require reassignment
actual: Deleted the 'Interest Income' category which had 1 assigned transaction (tx-9, Bank Interest). Confirmation dialog only warned 'Transactions using this category will not be deleted' with no reassignment step. After confirming, transaction tx-9's Category cell became blank instead of showing 'Unknown' or being reassigned/blocked.

evidence: Edited tx-1787695833799: changed description to 'QA Test Income Transaction Updated' and amount to 600. Table row and totals reflected changes immediately. Earlier, deleting a transaction (tx-1787695778784) removed it from the table.
Toggled Tax Related off during edit; table Tax column became blank. Toggled it back on in a subsequent edit; Tax column showed ✓ again and transaction reappeared in Tax Summary.

After unmarking tax-related, 2026 Tax Summary showed $0.00 income/0 transactions. After re-marking tax-related on the same transaction, Tax Summary immediately updated to $600.00 income, 1 transaction, with category breakdown 'Sales Revenue $600.00' and the transaction listed.

Tax Summary page for year 2026 shows Taxable Income ($600.00), Expenses ($0.00), Net ($600.00), category breakdown table (Sales Revenue $600.00), and the list of tax-related transactions (QA Test Income Transaction Updated, Aug 25 2026, +$600.00). Year selector allows choosing 2022-2026.
Clicked 'Print Report' for year 2026 and year 2024; page remained responsive with no new console errors triggered by the print action itself (window.print() invoked without throwing).

issue: Chart axis labels lack precision for values below $1,000 (including below $500)
actual: Dashboard 'Income vs Expenses' chart Y-axis, with an actual data point of $600 (August), shows tick labels ['$0k','$0k','$0k','$0k','$1k'] - four of the five ticks display as '$0k' even though they represent distinct non-zero values (e.g. $150, $300, $450), making them indistinguishable from zero on the axis.

evidence: Dashboard shows Total Balance ($74,931), Monthly Income ($600), Monthly Expenses ($0), Net Profit/Loss ($600), 'Income vs Expenses' trend chart (Mar-Aug), 'Expenses by Category' breakdown chart with legend (Salaries, Rent, Insurance, Travel, Office Supplies, Marketing), and Recent Transactions list (5 most recent).

Reports page for August 2026 shows Income $600, Expenses $0, Profit +$600, Income by Category (Sales Revenue $600), matching the single Aug 2026 transaction. Dashboard Monthly Income/Profit ($600) and Recent Transactions also match underlying transaction data.

Transactions table displays Date, Description, Category, Reference, Amount, and Tax (✓/blank) columns for every row, plus Total Income and Total Expenses summary for the current result set at the bottom of the page.
Searching 'INV-001' (a reference value) filtered the table to only tx-1 which has that reference. Searching 'Adobe' (a description keyword) filtered to only tx-10 'Software Subscription - Adobe CC'.

Type=Income filter showed only positive-amount transactions (8 rows). Adding Category=Sales Revenue narrowed to 4 rows, all Sales Revenue. Adding date range 2024-10-01 to 2024-11-30 narrowed further to 2 rows (Nov 1 and Oct 5, 2024) - date filter worked correctly.

Combined Type=Income + Category=Sales Revenue + Date range Oct1-Nov30 2024 yielded exactly 2 transactions (tx-11 Nov 1, tx-16 Oct 5), each satisfying all 3 criteria simultaneously. Clicking 'Clear Filters' restored the full 19-transaction set.

issue: Invalid date range (start > end) is not rejected or explained
actual: Set From=2024-12-31 and To=2024-01-01 (start later than end). The app did not reject the input or show any explanation of an invalid range; it silently accepted the values and displayed a generic 'No transactions found - Try adjusting your filters' empty state, giving no indication that the date range itself is invalid.
